_orgwave.title: Confluence
_orgwave.purpose: Create and update Confluence pages (e.g. playbook confluence-service-doc).
env: Launched via `orgwave/scripts/confluence-mcp-launch.mjs` (same deep-link pattern as GitHub).
CONFLUENCE_BASE_URL — pinned in this file unless set earlier (e.g. repo `.env`).

CONFLUENCE_USER_EMAIL / CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN — repo-root `.env` (envFile), or `~/.cursor/confluence-mcp.env` / `~/.config/orgwave/confluence-mcp.env`, or `export` them in `~/.zshrc` (filled only when still empty after `.env`).
